concepts.gloss_en: Chesed — the divine attribute/sefirah of lovingkindness (associated with Abraham)

reason_for_human: All 24 occurrences vocalize as חֶסֶד and mean the divine attribute of lovingkindness (the sefirah, repeatedly equated with Abraham, tzedakah, kohen, etc.). The plural חֲסָדִים and pausal חָסֶד in the biblical proof-quotes are inflectional variants of the same word, not homographs. No occurrence uses the alternate biblical sense of 'reproach/disgrace', so this is a single concept.
